events.detail: Integration platform, not an OAuth provider

classified.evidenceQuote: Each user connects their own accounts, their Gmail, their GitHub, their Slack, and Composio stores and refreshes those credentials against that userID .
classified.summary: Composio is an integration platform that lets users connect their accounts across various services so agents can execute tools on their behalf.
classified.instead: There's no OAuth app to register with the platform itself. If they need OAuth credentials for a specific app it connects to (e.g. Slack), they register an app with that provider; otherwise they can use the platform's own API key and its managed auth.
